claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Dimethyl 36 / 199 / 330 on K and any N-term variable
claims.evidence: PD PSM Modifications column lists exactly C(Carbamidomethyl), M(Oxidation), K and N-Term of Dimethyl, Dimethyl:2H(4), Dimethyl:2H(6)13C(2); paper says labeled N-term/K variable. Fixed/variable status of labels from paper text, not from the .pdResult workflow node
Raw header model string 'Orbitrap Fusion'; PRIDE lists Orbitrap Fusion ETD (differs, raw header and paper win)
Paper: digested overnight with trypsin 1:50 (Promega); PRIDE text silent (reconcile blocker answered with the paper)
Paper: 0.1 mol/L DTT; alkylation with 50 mmol/L iodoacetamide
Search parameters in data processing protocol
CID in ion trap, spectra acquired in Orbitrap at 15000 resolution; PD export Activation Type CID
Top-speed 3 s cycle; DDA implied by top-speed MS2 selection (inferred)
All 3 RAW files in v3 files/all; pdResult/export.7z files are search results and are not SDRF rows

limitations: Replicate-number to raw-file mapping inferred from file naming
No per-sample demographics (age, sex, ancestry) available
Modification fixed/variable status for labels not read from the .pdResult workflow node (multi-hundred-MB SQLite not parsed)
Channel (dimethyl) labels written as PRIDE DIMETHYL0/4/8 terms by post-processing the build output, since sdrf-tools build only recognises TMT/iTRAQ/SILAC channels
